title: Meta settlement opens new front in global fight over social media harm
title_zh: 元结算为全球应对社交媒体危害的斗争开辟了新战线
summary: By Byron Kaye and Karen Lema SYDNEY/MANILA, Aug 27 (Reuters) - Meta's move to restrict teenagers' use of social media in the U.S. shows companies have tools to better protect young people online,
summary_zh: Byron Kaye 和 Karen Lema 悉尼/马尼拉，8 月 27 日（路透社）——Meta 在美国限制青少年使用社交媒体的举措表明，公司拥有更好地保护青少年上网的工具，

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise as Nvidia, Salesforce earnings boost tech
title_zh: 今日股市：道指、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货上涨，英伟达、Salesforce 盈利提振科技股
summary: With Nvidia earnings in the rearview mirror, the focus turns to the Fed's Jackson Hole gathering.
summary_zh: 随着英伟达的盈利成为后视镜，焦点转向美联储的杰克逊霍尔会议。

title: Why Nvidia says its AI partnerships aren't 'circular financing'
title_zh: 为什么英伟达表示其人工智能合作伙伴关系不是“循环融资”
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) delivered another blockbuster quarter, beating Wall Street's expectations as demand for AI infrastructure continues to surge.
summary_zh: 随着人工智能基础设施的需求持续激增，英伟达 (NVDA) 再次实现了重磅季度业绩，超出了华尔街的预期。

title: Nvidia crushed earnings but one analyst is rating it a "sell"
title_zh: 英伟达盈利惨淡，但一位分析师将其评级为“卖出”
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) delivered a strong quarter, beating Wall Street expectations and offering a stronger-than-expected outlook. But with the AI trade already priced for near-perfection, even another blowout may not be enough to move investors.
summary_zh: 英伟达（NVDA）公布了强劲的季度业绩，超出了华尔街的预期，并提供了强于预期的前景。但由于人工智能交易的定价已近乎完美，即使再次出现井喷也可能不足以打动投资者。

title: Nvidia reports impressive Q2 earnings as AI boom rolls on
title_zh: 随着人工智能的蓬勃发展，英伟达公布了令人印象深刻的第二季度收益
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) reported another strong earnings report on Wednesday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $2.22 (compared to analyst estimates of $2.09), and revenue came in at $96.2B billion (compared to analyst estimates of $92.38 billion).
summary_zh: 英伟达（NVDA）周三收盘后公布了另一份强劲的盈利报告。调整后每股收益 (EPS) 为 2.22 美元（分析师预期为 2.09 美元），收入为 962 亿美元（分析师预期为 923.8 亿美元）。

title: Robots are the 'next gen' of AI: Why ETF investors are flocking back to tech
title_zh: 机器人是人工智能的“下一代”：为什么 ETF 投资者纷纷涌回科技领域
summary: Defiance ETFs chief investment officer Sylvia Jablonski explains why exchange-traded fund (ETF) investors are pouring back into the tech trade.
summary_zh: Defiance ETF 首席投资官 Sylvia Jablonski 解释了为何交易所交易基金 (ETF) 投资者重新涌入科技行业。

title: Meta's social media payout sets precedent for Snap, Google, Roblox — and could be a 'negative'
title_zh: Meta 的社交媒体支出为 Snap、谷歌、Roblox 开创了先例，而且可能会产生“负面影响”
summary: Meta (META) reached a settlement in its social media trial, agreeing to pay up to $16.7 billion, according to Reuters.
summary_zh: 据路透社报道，Meta (META) 在其社交媒体审判中达成和解，同意支付最多 167 亿美元。

title: Is Meta a buy after its $16.68 billion social media case settlement?
title_zh: Meta 在 166.8 亿美元的社交媒体案件和解后是否值得收购？
summary: The price of Meta (META) ticked up before paring gains after the company agreed it would pay $16.68 billion to settle a social media addiction case with a group of state attorneys general.
summary_zh: Meta (META) 同意支付 166.8 亿美元与州总检察长团队和解社交媒体成瘾案件后，该公司股价先上涨后回吐涨幅。

title: Stocks in holding pattern ahead of Nvidia earnings: AlphaCheck
title_zh: 英伟达财报公布前，股票处于持稳状态：AlphaCheck
summary: Stocks wavered at the opening bell on Wednesday as investors assessed fresh inflation data and upcoming earnings from AI bellwether Nvidia.
summary_zh: 周三开盘时，随着投资者评估新的通胀数据和人工智能领头羊英伟达即将发布的业绩，股市出现波动。
